import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
# Find red mask
r,g,b = a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]
red = (r>110)&(r-g>45)&(r-b>45)
ys,xs = np.where(red)
print(\"red bbox x:\",xs.min(),xs.max(),\"y:\",ys.min(),ys.max(),\"count:\",red.sum())
# connected components roughly: label
from collections import deque
lab = np.zeros(red.shape,int)
n=0
comps=[]
for sy in range(red.shape[0]):
    for sx in range(red.shape[1]):
        if red[sy,sx] and lab[sy,sx]==0:
            n+=1
            q=deque([(sy,sx)]); lab[sy,sx]=n; pts=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<144 and 0<=nx<256 and red[ny,nx] and lab[ny,nx]==0:
                        lab[ny,nx]=n; q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append(pts)
for i,pts in enumerate(sorted(comps,key=len,reverse=True)[:10],1):
    py=np.array([p[0] for p in pts]); px=np.array([p[1] for p in pts])
    print(f\"comp{i}: n={len(pts)} x[{px.min()},{px.max()}] y[{py.min()},{py.max()}]\")
